relationships.subject: pregnenolone sulfate
relationships.evidence_quote: Selective agonists of TRPM3 channels profoundly activated peripheral trigeminal nerve fibres in mouse meninges.

relationships.subject: CIM0216
relationships.evidence_quote: Hence, like PregS, CIM0216 induced profound firing activity in TG nerve terminals, especially in female mice

relationships.subject: Yoda1
relationships.evidence_quote: This indicates a lack of interaction (including sensitization) between TRPM3 and Piezo1 channels when sequentially activated in female mouse meninges.

relationships.subject: TRPM3
relationships.evidence_quote: suggest TRPM3 channels as a potential novel candidate for the generation of migraine pain, with particular relevance to females

key_findings: TRPM3 agonists PregS and CIM0216 evoked stronger nociceptive firing in meningeal trigeminal afferents of female than male mice, while Piezo1 (Yoda1) and TRPV1 (capsaicin) responses showed no sex difference.
No interaction between Piezo1 and TRPM3 activation was found.
